originalTitle: Senate confirms Trump ally Jay Clayton as director of national intelligence
summary: At confirmation hearing, Clayton sidestepped questions about 2020 election and declined to say Trump lost
content: The US Senate voted to confirm Jay Clayton as the director of national intelligence on Tuesday, giving Trump another key ally directing the nation’s intelligence apparatus. The tally, 51-47, fell along party lines, with all Republicans supporting his nomination and all Democrats opposing it. Clayton, currently the US attorney for the southern district of New York, will replace Bill Pulte, a staunch Trump loyalist who had been temporarily serving in the role since June. Trump’s first director of national intelligence, Tulsi Gabbard, resigned earlier this year. Clayton served as the chairman of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) during Trump’s first term. During his confirmation hearing on 15 July, Clayton sidestepped several questions about the 2020 election and declined to say that Trump lost it. During an interview on CNBC in June, Clayton also suggested there was something amiss about the long period California takes to count ballots. “We had a problem, a deep problem with voting in America,” he said on the network. “On the integrity side, we’re doing an absolutely terrible job, and the American people are right to question it.” Clayton also would not say during his confirmation hearing whether voter fraud was a problem in American elections, even though several studies have shown it is exceedingly rare. His office also issued widely-criticized subpoenas to New York Times journalists over their reporting on security concerns around Trump’s Air Force One airplane that was a gift from Qatar. The government abruptly withdrew those subpoenas during a court hearing in which a federal judge pressed an attorney from Clayton’s office about errors and irregularities in the subpoenas. While Democrats saw Clayton as a more preferable pick than Pulte, who has assisted in executing some of Trump’s sloppy and ugly acts of political retribution, including the criminal prosecution of Letitia James and a ham-handed effort to remove Lisa Cook from the Federal Reserve board of governors. Pulte was also leading the office of the director of national intelligence earlier this month when Trump declassified and released intelligence in support of false claims about the 2020 election. Pulte oversaw several rounds of layoffs at the agency. But Clayton’s contentious hearing earlier this month cost him bipartisan backing. Before the vote, the senator Ron Wyden, an Oregon Democrat, spoke in opposition to the nomination, warning that Clayton was unqualified and would act as the president’s “election conspiracy win”.
chineseTitle: 参议院确认特朗普盟友杰伊·克莱顿担任国家情报总监
chineseSummary: 在确认听证会上，克莱顿回避了有关 2020 年大选的问题，并拒绝说特朗普输了
chineseContent: 美国参议院周二投票确认杰伊·克莱顿(Jay Clayton)担任国家情报总监，为特朗普提供了另一个指导国家情报机构的关键盟友。计票结果为 51 比 47，按照党派划分，所有共和党人都支持他的提名，所有民主党人都反对。现任纽约南区联邦检察官的克莱顿将接替特朗普的坚定支持者比尔·普尔特，后者自 6 月以来一直暂时担任该职务。特朗普的第一任国家情报总监图尔西·加巴德(Tulsi Gabbard)今年早些时候辞职。克莱顿在特朗普第一任期内担任美国证券交易委员会（SEC）主席。在 7 月 15 日的确认听证会上，克莱顿回避了有关 2020 年大选的几个问题，并拒绝说特朗普输了。在 6 月份接受 CNBC 采访时，克莱顿还表示，加州计票时间过长是有问题的。 “我们在美国的投票方面遇到了一个问题，一个很严重的问题，”他在网络上说。 “在诚信方面，我们做得绝对糟糕，美国人民的质疑是正确的。”克莱顿在确认听证会上也不愿透露选民欺诈是否是美国选举中的一个问题，尽管多项研究表明这种情况极为罕见。他的办公室还向《纽约时报》记者发出了受到广泛批评的传票，因为他们报道了卡塔尔赠送的特朗普空军一号飞机的安全问题。在法庭听证会上，一名联邦法官就传票中的错误和违规行为向克莱顿办公室的律师施压，政府突然撤回了这些传票。虽然民主党人认为克莱顿是比普尔特更可取的人选，普尔特曾协助我
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
